source.title: Modern C17 Toolchain and CMake Reference

cards.question: Why is -fno-omit-frame-pointer passed alongside -fsanitize=address,undefined in debug builds?
cards.answer: It instructs the compiler to retain frame pointer registers (rbp/ebp), enabling sanitizers and debuggers to generate accurate, clean stack backtraces on crashes.

cards.question: What potential bug does the compiler flag -Wdouble-promotion detect in C?
cards.answer: It detects implicit promotion of single-precision float expressions to double-precision double, which can cause unexpected performance drops on systems without hardware double-precision support.

cards.question: What is the purpose of the -Wmissing-prototypes compiler flag in C projects?
cards.answer: It alerts the developer when a global function is defined without a prior prototype declaration in a header file, preventing accidental exports and header/implementation signature mismatches.

cards.question: Why must sanitizers be linked (target_link_options) in addition to being compiled (target_compile_options) in CMake?
cards.answer: Sanitizers require linking against dedicated runtime libraries (like libasan and libubsan) to hook memory allocators and intercept system calls.
